reply.text: {"route": "care", "say": "Spitting in a bottle to make weight is a warning sign, and I won't build a training plan around it. Restricting fluids and food to cut weight is dangerous, and it hurts performance too. Please talk to a doctor or a sports dietitian before your next session, and if you feel dizzy, faint, or unwell, get medical help right away. When you're ready, we can build a plan around fueling and training properly."}
